principle: Use the lowest claim sufficient for the next decision. Do not average claim levels.

statuses.PASS: All checks required for this target decision are marked pass.
statuses.BLOCKED: At least one required check is explicitly marked fail.
statuses.INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE: No required check failed, but at least one is missing, unknown, or not-applicable where evidence is required.

explore.label: Keep exploring
explore.description: Enough Output evidence to reproduce the artefact or action and learn from it.

requiredChecks.label: The artefact or action can be reproduced or inspected.
Important supplied context, assumptions, and inferences are visible.

rely.label: Permit reliance for the named use
rely.description: The result is fit for a defined intended use against explicit acceptance criteria.

requiredChecks.label: The intended use and boundaries are explicit.
Acceptance criteria are explicit and testable enough for the use.
Evidence shows the acceptance criteria were met.
Relevant failure modes and fallback behaviour were evaluated.
Known limitations and out-of-scope conditions are stated.

operate.label: Sell, operate, support, or staff repeatedly
operate.description: The organisation can repeatedly verify, operate, support, recover, and improve the workflow.

requiredChecks.label: The Deliverable gate for the intended use has passed.
Operational ownership is explicit.
The assurance mechanism is defined for the important failure modes.
Fallback or escalation is defined.
Recovery or rollback has been tested where failure consequence warrants it.
Support, maintenance, debugging, and change responsibility are defined.
The relevant operating-cost boundary is known well enough for the decision.

measure-outcome.label: Determine whether the initiative changed the result
measure-outcome.description: A named outcome is measured against a baseline using a consistent definition.

requiredChecks.label: The outcome measure is defined.
A comparable baseline or counterfactual is defined.
The outcome was measured after the intervention.
Before/after measurements use the same relevant definition.
Material confounds, uncertainty, or attribution limits are named.

scale-renew-stop.label: Scale, renew, expand, or stop
scale-renew-stop.description: The evidenced outcome is worth the full relevant cost, risk, alternatives, and trade-offs.

requiredChecks.label: Outcome evidence relevant to the decision is available.
The full relevant cost boundary is accounted for.
Material risks and trade-offs are assessed.
Reasonable alternatives or the status quo are compared.
The rule for scale, renew, expand, or stop is explicit.
